This alone does not determine whole SG fluid volume.

requiredForMassConversion: charging inlet enthalpy and boundary location
controlHistories.permittedUse: Volumetric measurement; mass-flow use must declare and bound conversion assumptions.

Held-out indicated level. A level-to-liquid-volume transfer function is required before interpreting it as a physical volume fraction.

controlHistories.availableEvidence: Authors describe spray activation limiting the pre-trip pressure increase; no measured spray-flow trace, valve coefficient, or quantitative controller schedule is supplied.
controlHistories.permittedUse: Documented missing input or explicitly bounded assumption; do not infer or fit spray flow from held-out pressure.

controlHistories.availableEvidence: Pressurizer heaters exist; no time-resolved measured power trace or complete event controller specification found.
controlHistories.permittedUse: Documented missing input or independently sourced component test; not a measured boundary.

controlHistories.availableEvidence: Narrative gives closure over approximately 5 s from 35.5 to 12.2 percent and operator reopening about 16 s; acquisition interval is 2 s.
controlHistories.permittedUse: Event annotations only. No synthetic dense series is represented as measured valve data.

unavailable.item: 2005 pressurizer vessel volume and level-to-volume mapping
unavailable.reason: No inspected primary source provides a directly applicable numeric volume/mapping. Secondary claims near 28 m3 were not adopted.
Operator total lacks boundary definition; historical 166.3 m3 geometry predates SG replacement. Detailed cited Pisa geometry tables are not accessible from the institutional record.

unavailable.item: 2005 replacement steam-generator secondary total and initial liquid volumes
unavailable.reason: Tube dimensions and nominal level cannot uniquely identify the equilibrium lumped fluid volumes.

unavailable.item: Effective fuel and structural heat capacities
unavailable.reason: Nominal fuel counts/mass do not specify temperatures, material properties, spatial storage or an equivalent lumped model.

unavailable.item: Heater/spray controller gains, setpoints, delays and measured commands
unavailable.reason: Qualitative control action is published; complete numeric histories and controller specifications were not found.

unavailable.item: Charging/letdown measurement conversion conditions and seal leakage
unavailable.reason: Litre-per-second curves are available, but reference density, meter locations, charging enthalpy and seal-flow histories are not identified.

policy.calibration: No fitting to pressure, temperature, or level response data.
policy.redistribution: Only numeric facts, original metadata and code are distributed. Source PDF artwork/prose are not bundled or relicensed.
policy.meaning: A sourced number does not by itself establish historical applicability or a model control-volume boundary.
